test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If A ÷ B means that A is the brother of B, A × B means that A is the sister of B, and A – B means that A is the father of B then which of the following expression shows that P is the paternal uncle of R?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbol:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

Given: 

A ÷ B means that A is the brother of B

A × B means that A is the sister of B

A – B means that A is the father of B

 
 

 **Symbol**
 **Symbol Denoted Relation**
 
 

 ÷ 
 Brother
 
 

 × 
 Sister
 
 

 -
 Father
 
 

**Find:- **Which expression shows that P is the paternal uncle of R.

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) **P - R ÷ Q

P is the father of R, and R is the brother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ac848a71c2943eea2b92826cb964bdd84a8e3b8ec02013b0a1674510fb49339.png] 

Here, P is the Father of R. (Incorrect)

**Option 2) **P ÷ R × Q 

P is the brother of R, and R is the sister of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4dec5627f20e2b4561c8729038ba5601b338911b7e91f300f9ea96a38bd0f7d.png] 

Here, P is the Brother of R. (Incorrect)

**Option 3) **P × R - Q 

P is the sister R, R is the father of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e752c4f022c65e1f91daddc01ed32e48e88bdb70d51faa45de85c446b2d7a6c3.png] 

Here, P is the Sister of R. (Incorrect)

**Option 4) **P ÷ Q - R

P is the brother of Q, Q is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c07a1622d388e918cd61b4637b94c89e8d6b4c88bebb8f8969e8a4b4089874d8.png] 

Here, P is the Paternal uncle of R. (Correct)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
